description: M/of Youth Affairs and Sports- Under Section 32 and 33 of Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 Temporarily Suspend the registration of Karate and Appointed a Woring Task Force
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, including the temporary suspension of Karate Do registration and appointment of a Working Task Force. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks under existing legislation, fitting Type 5 classification.
